<template>
	<section aria-label="refresh分流">
		<AsamField
			v-if="mounted"
			ref="fieldRef"
			v-model="value"
			:field="field"
			:mode="mode"
			:active="active"
		/><AsamButton @click="refresh" type="primary">调用refresh</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="release?.()" type="primary">结束等待</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="variant = variant === 'first' ? 'second' : 'first'" type="primary">
			切换字段 </AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="variant = 'none'" type="primary">无refresh控件</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="variant = 'native'" type="primary">原生字段</AsamButton
		><label><AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active" />激活</label
		><label><AsamCheckboxItem v-model="hidden" />隐藏</label
		><label><AsamCheckboxItem v-model="mounted" />挂载</label
		><label
			>模式<AsamSelect v-model="mode"
				><AsamOption value="edit" label="edit">edit</AsamOption
				><AsamOption value="detail" label="detail">detail</AsamOption
				><AsamOption value="query" label="query">query</AsamOption></AsamSelect
			></label
		>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamInput } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { computed, defineComponent, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { defineAsamControl, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamField } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldExpose, AsamFieldMode } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const first = ref(0),
	second = ref(0),
	done = ref(0),
	native = ref(0);
const active = ref(true),
	hidden = ref(false),
	mounted = ref(true);
const mode = ref<AsamFieldMode>('edit');
const variant = ref('first');
const value = ref<unknown>(null);
const fieldRef = ref<AsamFieldExpose>();
let release: (() => void) | undefined;
function control(key: string, withRefresh: boolean) {
	return defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
		sourceKinds: [],
		emptyValue: () => null,
		component: defineComponent({
			setup(_props, { expose }) {
				if (withRefresh)
					expose({
						refresh: async () => {
							if (key === 'first') first.value++;
							else second.value++;
							await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
								release = resolve;
							});
						}
					});
				return () => h(AsamInput, { 'aria-label': `探针${key}` });
			}
		})
	});
}
const controls = {
	first: control('first', true),
	second: control('second', true),
	none: control('none', false)
};
const source = defineAsamOptions().api({
	params: undefined,
	api: async () => {
		native.value++;
		return [{ value: 0, label: '零' }];
	}
});
const field = computed<AsamFieldDefinition>(() =>
	variant.value === 'native'
		? { kind: 'single', key: 'native', label: '原生', source }
		: {
				kind: 'custom',
				key: variant.value,
				label: '刷新探针',
				control: controls[variant.value as keyof typeof controls],
				isValue: () => true,
				emptyValue: () => null,
				isEmpty: (value) => value == null,
				format: () => '详情',
				query: (value) => value,
				submit: (value) => value,
				modes: {
					edit: { hidden: hidden.value },
					query: { hidden: hidden.value },
					detail: { hidden: hidden.value }
				}
			}
);
async function refresh() {
	await fieldRef.value?.refresh();
	done.value++;
}
</script>
